annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining the OneCoin business through recruitment and presents rapid network growth, very large turnover, and extraordinary personal earnings as evidence of the opportunity. The speaker explicitly highlights building a large downline, describes creating the compensation and reward plans, and the description directs viewers to learn about the business and become members. These claims and the recruitment call to action form an earnings-dependent hierarchy rather than neutral reporting or ordinary cryptocurrency commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted opportunity is organized around recruiting people into a network/downline and a compensation plan, with earnings and business success presented through member growth and turnover. The evidence shows more than a one-level referral: the speaker claims a large downline, describes building the reward and compensation plans, and promotes membership recruitment throughout Thailand.
